# Helpwise

Helpwise is an easy-to-use customer service platform that helps you manage all customer communication from a single place.

Category: Communication. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/helpwise/.

## Actions

- **Create attachment**: Upload a new attachment.
- **Delete Contact**: Delete a contact.
- **Delete Tag**: Delete a tag.
- **Delete Team**: Delete a team.
- **Get Conversation** (read-only): Retrieve details of a specific conversation.
- **Add note to conversation**: Add a note to a conversation.
- **Create Helpwise Team**: Create a new team.
- **Create Helpwise Webhook**: Create a new webhook in Helpwise.
- **Delete Helpwise Conversation**: Delete a conversation.
- **Delete Helpwise Message**: Delete a message.
- **Delete Helpwise Note**: Delete a note from a conversation.
- **Delete Helpwise Webhook**: Delete a webhook.
- **Delete Mailbox**: Delete a mailbox.
- **Delete Signature**: Delete an email signature.
- **Delete Template**: Delete a template.
- **Get Attachment**: Retrieve a specific attachment.
- **Get Conversation Attachments**: Retrieve attachments.
- **Get Conversation Note**: Retrieve details of a specific note.
- **Get Conversation Notes**: Retrieve notes for a conversation.
- **Get Conversations**: Retrieve a list of conversations.
- **Get Helpwise Contact**: Retrieve details of a specific contact.
- **Get Helpwise Mailbox**: Retrieve details of a specific mailbox by its ID.
- **Get Helpwise Mailboxes**: Retrieve mailboxes.
- **Get Helpwise Messages**: Retrieve messages for a specific conversation.
- **Get Helpwise Tag**: Retrieve a specific tag.
- **Get Helpwise Team**: Retrieve details of a specific team by its ID.
- **Get Helpwise Teams**: Retrieve Helpwise teams.
- **Get Helpwise Templates**: Retrieve Helpwise email templates.
- **Get Helpwise Users**: Retrieve Helpwise users list.
- **Get Helpwise Webhook**: Retrieve details of a specific webhook.
- **Get Helpwise Webhooks**: Retrieve Helpwise webhooks.
- **Update Helpwise Contact**: Update an existing Helpwise contact.
- **Update Helpwise Message**: Update an existing message.
- **Update Helpwise Tag**: Update an existing tag.
- **Update Helpwise Template**: Update an existing email template.
- **Update Mailbox**: Update an existing mailbox.
